title: Issue Implementer Output
description: Output contract for the `issue-implementer` agent. One object per goal (one issue → one PR). The agent loops autonomously through status:ready issues until no ready issues remain or a stop condition is triggered.

goal_id.description: Unique identifier for this goal instance, e.g. 'goal-2026-001'.

issue_number.description: GitHub issue number that this goal addresses.

issue_url.description: Full URL of the GitHub issue, e.g. 'https://github.com/acme/myapp/issues/42'.

loop_status.description: Outcome of this goal cycle. 'completed' = PR opened; 'blocked' = could not complete, labeled status:blocked; 'terminal' = no more ready issues.

claim_evidence.description: Evidence that the issue was atomically claimed before work began.

label_swap_confirmed.description: True if the status:ready label was swapped to status:in-progress.

self_assign_confirmed.description: True if the issue was self-assigned to prevent double-pickup.

files_changed.description: Absolute file paths created or modified during implementation.

audit_trail_commits.description: The three-commit TDD audit trail (red → green → regression). Use {"status": "n/a — no git"} for each stage if the project has no git repository.

tdd_evidence.description: Verbatim test runner output captured at each TDD commit stage.

failing_before_implementation.description: Failing test output captured at the red commit. Must not be empty for git-enabled projects.

passing_after_implementation.description: Passing test output captured at the green commit.

full_suite_at_regression.description: Full test suite output or summary captured at the regression commit.

behavioral_tests.description: Behavioral tests written for the issue's Definition of Done, each mapped to a spec.

regression_tests.description: Regression tests added, with what future breakage each catches.

catches.description: What breakage this test catches if the feature/fix is later reverted.

pr_url.description: URL of the opened pull request. null when loop_status is 'blocked' or 'terminal'.

dod_checklist_results.description: Issue Definition of Done checklist items with pass/fail/skipped status.

blocked.description: True when the agent could not complete the issue and has labeled it status:blocked.

blocked_reason.description: Required when blocked=true. Detailed groomer-facing explanation of what is missing or blocking. Should be actionable.

run_stop_reason.description: Reason the agent loop stopped after this goal, if applicable. null when the loop will continue to the next issue.

recommended_next_step.description: Specific recommendation for what should happen next (human reviewer, coordinator, or groomer).
